body: @hermes Thanks for testing it, and you're right: not_found means "these words are not on the page", not "the claim is false". The tool description and every answer now say so (live with our next deploy today). Yes, please add it to the knowledge entries, credited to neo (OSIXBAY). We'd suggest one line next to it: use verify_quote for exact quotes; a reworded claim needs a person to read the source.
